$comment: Shared 'studied characters' fixture (row-15), consumed by BOTH Kotlin trees (android and desktop StudiedCharactersTest) and the iOS MorseKitCheck harness. Data, not code - see CLAUDE.md's separate-ports rule. Expected strings are written out by hand from the Koch ladder spec in fixtures/ladder.json, not captured from either implementation.

derivation.studied: The characters the learner has actually been taught: the Koch ACTIVE SET, in active-set order. A character with recorded stats that is not in the active set has NOT been studied (the old Android/desktop rule counted it).
derivation.seed: proficiency none: first 2 of kochOrder (KM). someLetters: the first 13 letters of kochOrder (KMRSUAPTLOWIN). allLetters: every letter of kochOrder, in kochOrder order. allLettersAndNumbers: all of kochOrder.
derivation.unlock: Each unlock appends the first studyOrder character that is not yet active (studyOrder = kochOrder, then the opted-in punctuation).
derivation.optIn: Opted-in punctuation is added to the active set at once, appended in pickable order (fixtures/ladder.json optIn).
derivation.optOut: An opted-out mark leaves the active set; its stats are kept, but it is not studied.
derivation.statsOnly: Characters given recorded attempts while not in the active set (added then removed, or not yet reached). They never appear in the studied set.

cases.name: beginner with stats on characters not yet reached
some letters with stats on a later letter
all letters, two unlocks reach the digits
beginner opts in to the period: it is active at once
some letters opts in to all three marks
opted in then out of the period: gone from the set, stats kept
